meta.name: historical-catalog-backfill
meta.description: Render a promotable partition report from backfill-owned time windows and partition metadata.

argv:
python3 - <<'PY'
import datetime as dt
import json
import pathlib

request = json.loads(pathlib.Path("../inputs/capture_backfill_context/request").read_text())
window_start = dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(request["backfill_window_start_unix_ms"] / 1000, tz=dt.timezone.utc)
window_end = dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(request["backfill_window_end_unix_ms"] / 1000, tz=dt.timezone.utc)
duration_minutes = int((request["backfill_window_end_unix_ms"] - request["backfill_window_start_unix_ms"]) / 60000)
report_lines = [
    "# " + request["publication_title"],
    "",
    "Catalog: " + request["catalog_name"],
    "Partition: " + request["backfill_partition_key"],
    "Window start: " + window_start.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
    "Window end: " + window_end.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
    "Window minutes: " + str(duration_minutes),
]
out_dir = pathlib.Path("../outputs/publish")
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(out_dir / "report.md").write_text("\n".join(report_lines) + "\n")
(out_dir / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps({
    "catalog_name": request["catalog_name"],
    "partition_key": request["backfill_partition_key"],
    "backfill_window_start_unix_ms": request["backfill_window_start_unix_ms"],
    "backfill_window_end_unix_ms": request["backfill_window_end_unix_ms"],
    "window_minutes": duration_minutes,
    "publication_title": request["publication_title"]
}, indent=2) + "\n")
PY

cache.reason: historical partition publication should be regenerated for every backfill submission attempt
